caption: The drawing features five distinct objects arranged on a light beige background. On the left, there is a vertical rectangular panel containing a border design filled with various flowers and foliage in green, pink, yellow, brown, and red with fine line detailing and a section of fringe at the bottom. In the upper center, there is a symmetrical arrangement of flowers and leaves in a wide color palette including pink, yellow, green, blue, and red, with a central blue flower and flanking yellow and pink shapes. At the upper right, a blue floral branch with small buds and green stem is oriented diagonally. In the center below the floral arrangement, there is a single large, multi-lobed leaf shaded in green, yellow, and blue. At the lower right, two pinkish-red blossoms on green stems with a small yellow bird perched on one of the stems are shown. Colors in the drawing are predominantly pastel, and the objects are rendered in a delicate, watercolor-like style. The name "MARY BERNER" is inscribed in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Bedspread (Details)
